poc_details: 4-week Dedicated POC. Objectives: validate p95 latency < 180ms at sustained 50 req/s for chat and rerank; demonstrate canary rollout and rollback; prove region failover to eu-west-1 with <= 2s session continuity loss. Deliverables: telemetry feed to Redwood Console, cost per 1k tokens delta vs hosted, runbook for canary + rollback.
canary_plan_summary: Week 1: deploy model-variant v1 (quantized) to 5% traffic for 48h; monitor p50/p95 latency, error rate, unexpected token deltas. Week 2: increase to 25% if metrics stable for 24h. Week 3: full cutover to Dedicated pool at 100% with 1h quick rollback window. Rollback triggers: p95 > 250ms for 1h, error rate >1%, cost per token >30% over baseline. SE to implement automated fallback route to hosted-api when rollback occurs.
fallback_routing_plan: Primary: Dedicated (region na). Fallback sequence: 1) local Dedicated model-variant compatible (smaller quantized model), 2) hosted-api (Redwood hosted) in na region, 3) region failover to eu-west-1 Dedicated pool. Routing decisions based on latency SLO breach or capacity shortage. Session affinity maintained using request-level KV cache + client-side session tokens.
